crossRefs.note: “Let them announce and declare to us what will happen! Declare the former things, what they are, that we may consider…
Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we…
Who is like me? Who will call, and will declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people?…
Declare and present it. Yes, let them take counsel together. Who has shown this from ancient time? Who has declared it…
I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will…
The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs.…
“Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and…
For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and…
“All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.
I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring…
Yes, since the day was, I am he. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand. I will work, and who can hinder it?”
The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…
It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”
Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel…

translations.web: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
translations.bsb: I declare the end from the beginning, and ancient times from what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
translations.kjv: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
